name: My lil Acid Bass
author: Ari Klopfer / A_Development
description: Classic acid bass: the voice and the 32-step acid sequencer from the My lil acid bassline web synth and VST, as Rack modules

modules.name: Acid Bass
modules.description: Acid bass voice (saw/square, resonant 24 dB filter, accent, slide) with a 32-step sequencer and 32 pattern slots

modules.name: Acid Voice
modules.description: The acid bass voice on its own: V/Oct, gate, accent and slide in, cutoff and resonance CV, audio out
